main.description: Notify a syncing service of an update to a space. Sent by the space host to the notification endpoint registered through authorizeSpaceSync.

token.description: The token the endpoint was registered with.

repoWrite.description: A repo in the space advanced to a new revision.

prevSpaceRev.description: Omitted on the first update in a space. A gap indicates missed notifications, which can be recovered with listWriters.

repoRemoved.description: A repo was removed from the writer set.

prevSpaceRev.description: Omitted on the first update in a space. A gap indicates missed notifications, which can be recovered with listWriters.

spaceDeleted.description: The space has been deleted. Confirm with authorizeSpaceSync before dropping its data.

registrationExpired.description: The endpoint's registration has expired. Sent in place of the first update after expiry. Call authorizeSpaceSync to keep receiving notifications.
